Uncommon

---

[SET ADVOCATE = DEVIL'S]

While it is clear what the superior version of this card is *trying* to
say, the fact is that it missed the boat. And, since card text is all
we have to go on around here:

Of course the *strike* doesn't count against this vampire's additional
strikes. Strikes never do. Vampires (and other Minions) are restricted
in the number of "additional strike" effects that they may use - not in
the number of strikes that they may gain.

So, the superior of this card is exactly the same as the inferior -
making this card wallpaper when compared to Blur.

[SET ADVOCATE = NORMAL]
